entities.title: Production
entities.summary: The laumufarthegi Worker at icelander.net/games/laumufarthegi*, with its static page and the Room Durable Object namespace.
entities.purpose: The game players reach at icelander.net/games/laumufarthegi/ and the room links they share.
entities.deployedBy: The owner, from their own machine: `npm run deploy` in games/laumufarthegi with a Cloudflare token for the icelander.net account. Nothing deploys from GitHub's runners (the Deploy workflow was removed on 2026-11-23).
approvals: A pull request: main accepts nothing else.
The owner's say-so: only the owner, or an agent the owner asks, deploys.
entities.rollback: No rollback is recorded: deploy the previous commit again with `npm run deploy`, or roll back the Worker's version in Cloudflare's dashboard.
entities.details: The Durable Object class Room is created by the rooms-v1 migration in wrangler.jsonc (new_sqlite_classes) when the Worker first deploys; there is no D1 database, so the Database migration check has nothing of this game's to check. A change to games/word-lists/data/topic-grids.json goes live only when the game is next deployed by hand; on its own it does not even run this game's CI, because changed-games.sh looks only under games/laumufarthegi/.
